{{Quote|I can't say I approve of their methods (or their involvement in the Alliance considering their young age), but, like many other Rebel partisans throughout the galaxy, they are trying to do their small part against the Empire.|[[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]|<ref name="CRO" />}}
'''Allexia Evlan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. She was the [[Twin/Legends|twin]] sister of [[Allandria Evlan]].

==Biography==
Evlan lived in the [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]], along with her widowed aunt and her twin sister [[Allandria Evlan]]. The twins spent most of their time in school and many of their classmates were the children of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officers and workers at [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. The twins gained a lot of attention from their male classmates and would both date different boys every few days. They chose dates who had parents in important positions and would try to steer conversation to how Kuat Drive Yards was doing in an attempt to learn information about the shipyards. They often gathered information about naval deployments and shipyard schedules which they passed on to to an old friend of theirs who was a member of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance cell]].<ref name="CRO" />

==Personality and traits==
Allexia and Allandria were attractive and dressed in the latest styles. They were cunning and used their wits and charm to pry information out of their boyfriends.<ref name="CRO" />

==Skills and abilities==
Despite being a teenager, Allexia and her sister were incredibly gifted and flirting with their classmates to manipulate them for the Alliance's needs. They were also talented pick pockets and had skills with security systems, searching, investigations, and intimidation.<ref name="CRO" />

==Equipment==
As students Allexia and her sister only carried data notebooks and data book cartridges.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Allexia Evlan was designed by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] for ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1994]]. She was illustrated by [[Mike Vilardi]].
